name: TERMINAL/SHELL_
source:
A short kinetic novel centering around a conversation between an ukagaka and her programmer about a strange dream, advancements in AI and what it means to be human. 

—Although, sometimes a conversation is just a conversation. It really has no inherent depth nor meaning.

[From [url=https://23noko.itch.io/terminalshell]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部简短的动态小说，围绕一个ukagaka和她的程序员之间的对话展开，内容涉及一个奇怪的梦、人工智能的进步以及人类的意义。

——不过，有时候谈话就只是谈话而已。它确实没有内在的深度或意义。

[来自[url=https://23noko.itch.io/terminalshell]itch.io[/url]]
